gameDescriptionHtml:
Knights in Tight Spaces is a turn-based tactical game in the same universe as Fights in Tight Spaces. It is a standalone title that sends us back to medieval times, building on the much-loved gameplay in new and dynamic ways.

Game Features

  • A Stylish, Action Packed Take on Deckbuilders – Knights in Tight Spaces’ battles have a striking and stylish appearance, with strong action-movie visual effects and animations. Vibe with the electronic soundtrack and battle your way through action-packed levels that will put your strategic thinking to the test.
  • Gather Your Party and Control the Environment – Winning is not just a matter of playing your best hand, but also learning how to master your surroundings. Recruit new characters and assemble your party carefully: Deck synergies and team-up moves will be key to keep your tactical advantage. But remember, always be careful with who you choose and who you reject in your team! Friend or foe, sometimes they are just two sides of the same coin…
  • Find Your Playstyle – With 300 cards, different classes and gear to equip, and the upgrading system, Knights in Tight Spaces offers you countless hours of deckbuilding fun. If you’re up for a challenge, climb the Daily Play leaderboard or prove your toughness in the Endless mode.
